756510101.text: #Y'know, {NICKNAME}, Paimon can see that the commissions have been pretty taxing lately.

756510102.text: As a thoughtful, capable guide, Paimon's duty is to help you relax, so... Ta-da! Guess where this is?

756510104.text: Hello there. Welcome to Damoville Purveyor.

756510107.text: This is no ordinary store. This is a place where hardworking laborers relax via spending money.

756510108.text: Indeed, indeed! In fact, we have recently launched a buy one get one free promotion, with all customers welcome to take part!

756510109.text: My loss if you buy, your loss if you don't!

756510110.text: Hehe, Paimon saw the event poster when we passed by before. That's how she remembered it.

756510111.text: Double the goods for every purchase sounds like a great deal, no matter how you slice it!

756510112.text: It always feels like there's something missing in Paimon's day if she doesn't spend some Mora here... So today, we're coming here together to fill that gap!

756510106.text: Dear me, dear customer, do not speak such inaccuracies. Damoville Purveyor is committed wholly to affordability and quality. You may survey our prices should you wish.
